title: Seedream 5 family provider-aware prompt adapter
when_to_use: When preparing a model-specific image prompt for Seedream 5 family.
method: Verify exact model/provider identity and current controls before compile.
Distinguish version branding from provider API availability, required asset types and output resolution.
Compile an input/reference/action/preservation/output contract tailored to supported parameters. Never present text-prompt wishes as actual API settings.
failure_modes: unsupported numeric resolution or image-input limits
verification: Adapter candidate, requiring provider documentation re-check and live generation validation.
